title: Resource category, tag and author canonicals remove the locale
evidence: 303 live pages declare a locale-free canonical. The source category/tag/author generateMetadata functions return /resources/... instead of the actual /in, /in-ta or /in-hi URL. Shared normalization probes demonstrate representative locale-free targets redirecting to /in. Current raw evidence and all affected URLs are listed in evidence/technical-analysis.json.
business_impact: Contradictory canonical/redirect signals complicate page consolidation; translated pages nominate the same locale-free identity. This does not establish Google-selected canonicals or an indexing loss.
recommended_fix: Reuse existing localizeMetadata/buildAlternates in /Users/saai_mithra/Projects/Start_Up/LetBuyy/apps/marketing/web/src/lib/i18n/metadata.ts and routing.ts. Change the three resource templates to generate absolute final locale canonicals; preserve navigation, sitemap and schema agreement. Do not rewrite a working helper or create a second SEO system.
effort: 0.5–1 engineer day including template tests; excludes release
dependencies: Decide which archive types should remain indexable; preserve genuine translated equivalents.
validation_steps: Recrawl every category/tag/author in all three locales; each retained indexable page has one absolute self-canonical returning200. Test sampled language alternates and URL normalization. Later inspect Google-selected canonicals when GSC is available.
success_indicator: 0 redirecting or locale-stripped canonicals among retained intended indexable pages.

title: Creation chooser inherits homepage metadata and language alternatives
evidence: All captured locale creation pages display Create Your Site (translated where applicable) but inherit homepage title/description/canonical and homepage hreflang targets. Their distinct chooser is listed in the XML sitemap.
business_impact: A distinct acquisition page is described as a homepage duplicate; metadata does not express its task. Whether it should be an organic landing page is a product decision.
recommended_fix: In /Users/saai_mithra/Projects/Start_Up/LetBuyy/apps/marketing/web/src/app/[locale]/create/page.tsx, provide task-specific localized metadata/self-canonical if retained for indexing, or deliberately noindex/exclude the chooser if it is only a signup step. Keep homepage consolidation only if the page is actually duplicative.
validation_steps: Check all three locale source responses, headings, canonical/alternates, index directive and sitemap agreement; complete a safe chooser navigation sample without submitting signup.
success_indicator: 3/3 chooser URLs follow the chosen consistent indexing/metadata policy.

title: Internal search pages are indexable, sitemap-listed and canonicalize to home
evidence: The three base resource-search pages emit index/follow, inherit homepage canonical and homepage hreflang, reuse a resource index title and have no H1. All three appear in sitemap.xml. Query-result variants were deliberately not expanded.
business_impact: Unrelated consolidation and public indexing signals disagree. This is not proof of large-scale search-result index bloat.
recommended_fix: Choose an explicit internal-search indexing policy. Usually noindex the search UI/results and remove them from sitemap; keep crawler access to see noindex and preserve category/article links. Give the page a useful main heading for users. Do not indiscriminately robots-block the pages before Google can read exclusion directives.
dependencies: TECH-01 final URL policy; preserve article discovery.
validation_steps: Check initial HTML robots directives, H1 and exclusion from sitemap for all locales; verify all approved articles remain reachable from normal links. Sample only a bounded real query after policy is implemented.
success_indicator: All3 search routes have intentional indexing policy; no search URLs in the canonical sitemap when excluded.

title: XML sitemap omits every discovered localized article
evidence: 105/105 inspected localized articles are absent from the99-entry XML sitemap. The static sitemap source expands core/category/legal paths only; getAllArticlesForSitemap() already exists in src/lib/resources/utils.ts but is unused by the sitemap.
business_impact: Weakens an important discovery/canonical inventory channel; articles remain internally linked, so omission does not prove they are unindexed.
recommended_fix: Generate entries from the existing published article registry and actually available translations. Include approved, indexable final200 URLs with canonical agreement and correct alternates; remove search/noncanonical aliases according to policy. Correct public content claims before amplifying discovery. Do not create another article authority.
effort: 0.5–1 engineer day plus editorial eligibility review
dependencies: TECH-01/02/03 canonical/indexing decisions; CONTENT factual/availability corrections.
validation_steps: Compare expected approved article set to sitemap set; set difference must be empty. Fetch each intended sitemap URL, check status/index directive/canonical, and validate reciprocal alternate sets. Confirm GSC processing later if access exists.
success_indicator: 100% coverage of approved indexable published article equivalents;0 invalid/noncanonical/excluded sitemap URLs.

title: Sitemap lastmod is a fixed June date despite later release content
evidence: All99 sitemap lastmod values equal2026-06-04T00:00:00.000Z. Changelog/releases visibly include22July2026 updates. Source hardcodes one June4 Date for every route, so this is stronger evidence than identical dates alone.
business_impact: Misrepresents significant updates on at least the release/changelog pages; does not prove all99 pages changed after June4 or that Google penalized the site.
recommended_fix: Use real significant content modification dates owned by each content source; omit lastmod where no trustworthy value exists. Do not replace the fixed date with build time. priority/changefreq are ignored by Google and need not become a separate fix.
dependencies: Trustworthy content modification fields and TECH-04 sitemap generation.
validation_steps: Inspect all lastmod values against corresponding significant-content history. A no-content-change rebuild must not advance them; a real release/article edit should advance the correct entry only.
success_indicator: No known stale or fabricated lastmod values; unaffected URLs retain their true dates.

title: Pricing lacks a primary heading and descriptive page title
evidence: All three pricing source responses have zero H1 headings; the reusable Pricing component renders its main heading as H2. English title is simply Pricing. Other locales also have no H1. Client-only plan loading is handled in the content/performance findings, not duplicated here.
business_impact: The commercial page lacks a clear primary document heading and specific search-result title; this is not a standalone indexing blocker.
recommended_fix: Add a page-level localized H1 and a descriptive title using approved offer facts. Make the shared pricing section accept heading context or use a separate page wrapper so the homepage subsection remains H2. Synchronize visible prices, metadata and schema with the canonical pricing authority.
dependencies: Approved offer facts; pricing SSR work coordinated separately.
validation_steps: Check raw/rendered HTML for one useful H1 on each pricing page; homepage retains its own primary H1 and pricing H2. Validate price/title truth against the actual public offer.
success_indicator: 3/3 pricing routes have task-specific titles and one meaningful primary heading.

title: Article entities and breadcrumbs do not use final localized identities
evidence: All105 captured articles use locale-free relative mainEntityOfPage.@id and relative breadcrumb items. Article.image and author.url/sameAs are absent; 30 article variants model LetBuyy Team as Person. All inspected JSON-LD parses; syntax success is not semantic validation.
business_impact: Creates inconsistent identities between visible final page URL, article entity and hierarchy; omits helpful genuine author/image connections. Relative JSON-LD URLs alone are not a syntax failure; author/image fields are recommendations, not universal Article requirements.
recommended_fix: Use absolute final locale URL for article @id/url/mainEntityOfPage and breadcrumb items. Reuse Organization @id for publisher. Link genuine bylines to final author profiles; use Organization for the team. Add an accurate representative visible article image with an absolute URL if useful. Do not invent reviewers or credentials.
dependencies: TECH-01 final URLs; verified author facts; approved representative artwork.
validation_steps: Parse every block; assert identity and breadcrumbs match final canonical hierarchy. Dereference selected author/image URLs, check visible truth, and run Schema Markup Validator plus Google Rich Results Test on samples. Do not treat tool eligibility as guaranteed display.
success_indicator: All approved article entities match final locale canonical; team/individual authors represented truthfully.

title: Social previews lack consistent page images and final URLs
evidence: Within inspected locale pages, 486 lack og:image, 483 lack og:url, 69 lack og:type; 6 explicit og:url values differ from canonical. Homepage lacks image/url/type; English pricing points og:url to/pricing although canonical is/in/pricing. Local source has some image work not yet reflected in live HTML.
business_impact: Can produce incomplete or inconsistent shared-link previews; do not describe missing Open Graph fields as a demonstrated Google ranking loss.
recommended_fix: Complete existing metadata inheritance: final localized URL, appropriate website/article type and accessible preview image with dimensions/alt. Preserve completed local image work. Prefer a supported raster preview rather than relying on the pricing page's narrow SVG logo. Make live output the acceptance target after authorized release.
dependencies: TECH-01 final URL policy; existing brand/social assets.
validation_steps: Inspect raw source for all representative templates/locales and preview with actual social consumers. Check final200 image URLs, preview crop and matching og:url/canonical. Recheck deployed output independently of localhost.
success_indicator: Intended preview image, URL and type are consistent across approved shareable pages.

title: Unknown tags return indexable empty200 archives
template_or_page: One live negative probe; likely template-wide by source
evidence: The deliberate unknown-tag probe returns200, index/follow, the arbitrary slug in title/H1, and0articles / No articles found for this tag. Canonical also points to an unlocalized arbitrary tag. Exactly one invalid tag was tested; unbounded acceptance is also visible in source, not inferred as thousands of indexed URLs.
business_impact: Allows empty URL variants to look like valid indexable archive pages. Google soft404 classification and actual index bloat are unverified.
recommended_fix: Check the existing tag registry before metadata/rendering and return notFound() for unknown tags. Preserve intentional known tags and their links. Do not solve an absent-content page solely with a homepage canonical.
dependencies: Existing tag registry; TECH-01 archive canonical policy.
validation_steps: Known tags still return200 with correct content; unknown tags in each served locale return404 with noindex and useful navigation. Do not generate or crawl a large invalid-slug corpus.
success_indicator: 0 indexable200 responses in bounded invalid-tag tests.

title: RSS links and feed identity omit the served locale
template_or_page: Two feed samples;35item links per sample
evidence: Captured RSS samples contain35item links each, all pointing to locale-free/resources/... URLs. English and sampled Tamil feed bodies identify language as en-in and publish the same English item titles; self URL omits the route locale. The feed is present and parseable; this is a consistency issue, not a missing feed.
business_impact: Feed readers and crawlers follow redirecting identities; a translated route suggests language-specific output but delivers English. Does not establish lost subscriptions or indexing.
recommended_fix: Either provide one explicitly English feed and link all locales to that final identity, or localize feed entries/language/self URL using the existing locale/content authority. Emit final canonical article links and permalink GUIDs; changing old GUIDs may duplicate reader entries, so choose the feed migration intentionally.
effort: 0.5 engineer day including feed-reader compatibility review
dependencies: TECH-01 final URLs; explicit feed-language policy; article translation availability.
validation_steps: Parse feed XML; every item link resolves final200 canonical; channel language, title and atom:self agree with intended feed scope. Compare EN/TA samples and check reader deduplication behavior before changing established GUIDs.
success_indicator: No redirecting article item URLs; feed route/identity/content language follow documented policy.

title: Software app rich-result eligibility is not established
evidence: The global SoftwareApplication graph on all489 inspected locale pages lacks a rating/review. Google's checked SoftwareApplication feature documentation requires a genuine rating or review along with name/offer. Existing graph JSON parses.
business_impact: Cannot claim this markup is eligible for Google software-app rich results. Absence of public reviews may be correct and should not be hidden by fabricated data.
recommended_fix: Keep truthful semantic markup if useful; correct the contradictory offer separately. Only include a rating/review when genuine, visible and compliant. Otherwise accept lack of this optional search feature and validate the types actually supported by the page.
effort: 0.25 engineer day for validation; genuine review collection is not estimated
dependencies: Approved offer facts; legitimate visible review data only if available.
validation_steps: Run Google Rich Results Test on a representative page and record exact type/errors. Validate Schema.org semantics separately. No synthetic rating, review, reviewer or count may appear.
success_indicator: Eligibility claims match real validation;0 fabricated rating/review fields.
